metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent used cvlc with --start-time=3 --stop-time=8 to clip src.mp4. The trajectory showed VLC command-line being used for video processing. Rather than frame extraction, this variation asks for direct clip transcoding.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can use VLC command-line with start-time/stop-time flags, transcode video files
metadata.failure_analysis: Original failure was at GIMP layer selection, not at VLC processing. Agent demonstrated VLC start/stop time clipping.
metadata.task_rationale: Variant of the VLC extraction task: instead of extracting PNG frames, transcode directly to a shorter MP4 clip. Uses the same demonstrated VLC command-line skill but targets a different output format. src_clip.mp4 won't exist initially.
metadata.explanation: Agent must run a VLC transcode command to produce /home/user/Desktop/src_clip.mp4 (5-sec clip from 00:03). Evaluator checks file exists, size >= 10000 bytes, and duration within [4.5, 5.5] seconds (verified via ffprobe). Initial state has no src_clip.mp4, so negative control passes. [Fixed: renamed function suffixes from invalid 8-char '01c89da3' to proper 32-char MD5 'ea8c7a7a44f5cb78e25fd89d658a863f'; Fixed: added ffprobe duration check to getter and metric to enforce 5-second clip requirement]

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly checks file existence at /home/user/Desktop/src_clip.mp4 and returns size (via stat) and duration (via ffprobe) — correct path and complete state extraction after Fix 4.

Metric correctly handles the 'type: rule' expected parameter: expected IS the rules dict, and metric directly accesses expected.get('min_size', 1), expected.get('min_duration', None), expected.get('max_duration', None) — no nested 'rules' key access, which is correct.
Duration check is now enforced (Fix 4-6): getter returns ffprobe-measured duration, metric rejects clips outside [4.5, 5.5] seconds. This covers the core '5-second clip' requirement.
Size check (min_size=10000 bytes) filters out empty/trivial outputs and ensures a real video file was produced.
Negative control is correctly satisfied: src_clip.mp4 does not exist in the initial state, so a do-nothing agent will fail.
Metric returns 0.0 for duration=-1.0 (ffprobe failure or non-video file), preventing false positives from non-MP4 files with the right size.

Minor gap: The start time (00:03) is not verified. A clip from any 5-second window of the source video would pass. However, automated start-time verification requires frame-level comparison with the source video, which is infeasible in a lightweight evaluator. The 5-second duration constraint is the critical correctness requirement.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Optional improvement: To verify start time (00:03), one could extract the first frame of src_clip.mp4 and the frame at t=3s of src.mp4 using ffmpeg, then compare them with an image similarity metric. This is complex but would provide full coverage.
